integrity: Proof and a standard-library rational checker are included; the checker provides finite supporting tests only. No independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional unweighted cross-norm theorem for tau,kappa>0. Smoothness and general prediction framework are prior work. No numerical experiment alone proves universal sharpness; literature priority risk persists.
title: Sharp robustness and finite-input nonattainment for Shannon–quadratic simplex prediction
